# Cartridges NOT opted in to `dxf-aama` by the commons sweep (opt_in_export_format.py).
#
# Each one fails the platform's DXF-AAMA conformance lane (fashion-cabinet
# `scripts/qa/verify_dxf_aama.py --all`, run over commons 79c3d1b with the fc
# kernel at fashion-cabinet main 22d147b): the named piece is authored with
# `grainline=None`, so its file would carry no layer-7 grain line and a cutter
# could not lay it. Fix = add a `fc.Grainline` to that piece in the cartridge's
# main.py (one object per PR), then add "dxf-aama" to its manifest and delete
# its line here.
